versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02089 The AUTOSAR COM module shall execute the configured timeout handling steps in the following order: 1. perform the configured ComRxDataTimeoutAction 89 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 2. call the configured <ComUser_CbkRxTOut> 3. notify Dem if COM_E_TIMEOUT is configured
